1.name: Nick Boyle
1.bio: projected top pick, steady stats for two years, pro offense, capable of making changes at the line, cerebral with pro traits

2.name: Dannie Montano
2.bio: good arm, great stats, returned to raise stock, great when the pocket breaks down, great advanced stats on the move throws

3.name: Micah Howard
3.bio: classic shut down corner, elite inbetween the ears, top pick outside of QB, mirrors receivers step for step consistently

4.name: Dylan Smith
4.bio: another high georgia dline, could be the best of the bunch, great size at 6'5", one year of prod but elite eye test

5.name: Trey Sternberg
5.bio: different bread of oline, has the nasty streak needed in the run game but truly excells in elite pass pro

6.name: Jaylen Scruggs
6.bio: dynamic receiving threat in all ways, true make you miss in a phone booth, elite speed and change of direction

7.name: Ramello Williams
7.bio: tremendous pass russher, broad array of moves to get to the qb, good sack and pressure #'s over two solid years

8.name: Tremon Henderson II
8.bio: elite tools DB, witht the size and skill to eliminate one half of the field, needs to put out more consistent tape

9.name: Tyler Smit
9.bio: big body deep threat who excels getting downfield and making contested catches, elite release off the line and great knack for getting TD's

10.name: Amani Okonkwo
10.bio: small in size but thick frame allows him to bounce off defenders, former track star aswell so has the speed to get behind cb's

11.name: Jake Rosario
11.bio: elite pass catching TE capable of lining up all over the field, elite hands and has shown a knack for making big block on big plays

12.name: Judah Dickinson
12.bio: overwhelming run blocker, strongest player in class, elite strong hands that really push defenders off the line of scrimmage

13.name: Malik Smith
13.bio: great instincts and real thumpher in the run game, can be a captian of a defense, elite tape

14.name: Brayan Myles
14.bio: fastest corner in the draft, despite small size consistently competes with bigger recievers, atheltic marvel

15.name: Ja'Kylan Edwards
15.bio: big press corner who excels in jamming recievers off the line and messing up routes before they begin, elite play strength for corner

16.name: Kentrell Williams
16.bio: big phhysical deep threat with a former track background, great at catching deep go balls, show WR 1 potential

17.name: Saka Joseph
17.bio: started career at alabama but saw limited playing time, really burst on to the scene at his second stop, great pass rusher for dt, athletic

18.name: Jake Denney
18.bio: size at 6'3" and good arm and mobility, 5 star who started one year at notre dame, trasnfered and sat, decent stats 1st year

19.name: Jaishawn Brown
19.bio: great size and instincts for a shiftier back at 6'2", can run over you or get by you with a reliable set of open field moves

20.name: Mosi Sidi
20.bio: high school track star who started playing football late, can be used in all types of ways and packages, great kick/punt returner

21.name: Ron Hopkins
21.bio: physcial slot reciever whit recruiting pedigree and solid tape producing in a stacked ohio sate offense

22.name: Arvydas Miliauskas
22.bio: older player at 25 but and elite technician at the position, one of the best pass rushers in the nation, veteran prescense

23.name: Markus Saylor Jr
23.bio: another big body deep threat in this class, has more shiftiness then the rest, can catch, make a move and get up field in a hurry, great size

24.name: Khassim Hayes
24.bio: elite athletic traits for a rush end, elit bend and wiggle to get around stiffer tackles, can really run for a dline

25.name: Jean-Luc Toussaint
25.bio: elite size at 6'4" and vertical pop, good coverage skills, 3 star recruit at safety who trasnfered from arizona state, converted to corner

26.name: Zaire Rollins
26.bio: fits the modern mold of a pro lb, good athleticism and traits to consistently prod at the next level

27.name: Jaiden Staples-Harris
27.bio: 5 star recruit with 1 year of prod, is the most physically gifted at the postion in the class, great vision and juke move, can catch too

28.name: Xander Haynes
28.bio: acnhor for a strong iowa dline, no run gets pass him, great base strength with the ability to plug any interior gap on the oline

29.name: Eric Fahey
29.bio: another michigan te projected in the 1st rnd, top 3 hands the class and is great at getting 1st downs and reliably open

30.name: Conner McPherson
30.bio: big lb, former iowa state star who is set to play at texas a&m this year, will be in consideration for best lb in the nation

31.name: Davion Lee
31.bio: elite athletic traits and wiggle for an end, undersized but is set for a big season this year with a larger role

32.name: Matt Osborne
32.bio: classic nose tackle who holds the middle of the line intanct, great at the point of attack in the run game with great tackling skills
